comparison.objective: Extract the bottom bar from a pile while supporting the bars resting on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Support a load with one action while sliding a load-bearing member free with another.
comparison.success_condition: Bottom bar removed and carried bars controlled; detailed displacement/drop limits are unavailable.
comparison.reason: It shares bimanual stabilization during removal, but tests quasi-static load transfer and extraction rather than impulsive notch fracture plus recovery of newly freed fragments.
